2030 Goal: Community Impact
Description. Deliver 10 million volunteer hours to improve our local 
communities, including an increase in skills-based volunteerism.
Baseline. Progress measured from baseline of January 1, 2020.
Progress in 2023. During 2023, our employees volunteered 
1,013,000 hours of service in our local communities. As of the end 
of 2023, we had reached approximately 3.8 million hours of service 
toward our 10 million-hour goal. 
Looking Ahead. In 2024, our objective is to reach another  
1 million volunteer hours and to continue to expand our skills-based 
volunteering activities.
